## Houston 0.6.23

### Your work is not interrupted

- **An answer in progress finishes before Houston restarts**, so an update never cuts a reply in half.
- **A stuck turn tells you it is stuck**, instead of quietly repeating itself.

### Routines that run as they should

- **A routine woken by an event runs as the person who set it up**, with the right access.
- **The routine screen stops spinning forever** when a trigger is slow to answer.

### Fixes and polish

- **Choosing a model stays within what your agent is allowed to use.**
- **A model running on your own computer stays connected**, even when the desktop sits idle.
- **Saving or opening a downloaded file explains itself** instead of showing a raw error.
- **Signing in to Claude without internet says you are offline**, plainly.
- **Long answer options stay fully readable** in a narrow chat panel, with their numbers in view.
- **What you pin to a message is attached when you send it.**
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.
